sample.rule: reuse the previously frozen temporally safe subset: March scaledIFBFat nonmissing and raw migration start strictly after March 31

primary_models.centering: global centering within the safe analysis sample before forming the interaction

sensitivity.model: within-year centered response, DFP_Start and scaledIFBFat; interaction formed from the within-year centered predictors

outcome_rule.if_interaction_ci_excludes_zero: label READINESS_MODULATION_SUPPORTED for that actuator only; still not H2 because the dataset does not span a closed versus open readiness gate
outcome_rule.if_interaction_ci_includes_zero: label READINESS_MODULATION_UNRESOLVED; retain H1_CANDIDATE and channel dissociation

boundaries: interaction is observational moderation, not causal gating
IFBFat is a readiness proxy/candidate, not direct G
all analyzed actuator responses occur after migration start
do not relabel a significant interaction as H2
